payload.claim: citation_count_and_defects's docstring now only describes a file-missing/range-past-end refusal plus, when movable is true, the new no-single-holder refusal. It drops the prior sentence describing the construct-mismatch check (_construct_defect, the 'the construct it names sits at ...' defect), which still runs unconditionally on every call regardless of movable. A reader of this docstring would not learn that this long-standing refusal path still exists, since the text now reads as if the only non-file refusal is the new movable-only one.
